comment: Pinned versions for everything this action installs. Keys are flattened into
SPIRE_DEV_<UPPER_SNAKE> environment variables by scripts/lib/versions.sh, and an
already-set variable of the same name always wins, so any value here can be
overridden from the environment or by an action input.
Override the whole file with the versions-file input.

spireExamples.comment: Source of the deb/rpm packages used by host mode.

charts.comment: helm-charts-hardened. spire-crds must be installed as its own release first.

timeouts.comment: Seconds, except helm* which are helm duration strings.
